review.notes: All 17 source/Greek pairs read in full; two self-caught phrases and the chum-bucket promotion corrected and re-read. The English general-store reference in the low-quality Willy variant is retained as source, not silently changed to fish shop. Neuter item/odor/adjective agreement and all article branches match batch20 and Lexicon. NPC hate fragments preserve leading space and referent while using natural Greek subject omission. Native ArticleFor resolver is blank outside English, so the shop recommendation retains its placeholder next to an explicit neuter αντικείμενο.
